digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program and observability infrastructure
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation time and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.

Pre-LLM deterministic gates must exist to prevent raw git writes, unread config fields, wall-clock assertion violations, incomplete AC checkboxes, stale code comment references, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python using the strangler-fig pattern.
Canary and automation bug filing must follow a hardened deduplication pattern with a documented bug-creation contract and pinned field asymmetries validated by property tests.

Engine-layer validation placement must be advisory-enforced at plan-review time, and code comments referencing dead SHAs or run-ids must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention.

Epic completion attestation was retroactively missing due to stale-material reads after checkbox-normalization; grandfathering logic in compute_validity must restore certified status for pre-normalization children and enable valid signed attestation.
